subject: Unexpected connector charges & VAT applied to marketplace credits
messages:
From: Jordan Pierce <finance@faststream.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected connector charges + VAT on marketplace credits

Hi Camila,

I hope you’re well. We were reconciling April invoices and noticed two issues we'd like help with:

1) Several connector overages were billed to our account on 2027-04-01 for the Salesforce Connector (line items on invoice #2027-04-01-INV-8897). We had previously purchased marketplace credits through Redwood’s partner program that should have covered connector transactions for our reserved enterprise connector allowance. The invoice shows $4,312.45 charged to our card.

2) VAT was applied to those connector charges. FastStream is US-based (EIN on file) and we expected no VAT on these marketplace credit redemptions.

I attached the invoice and a brief usage summary. Can you confirm why the marketplace credits were not applied and whether the VAT charge can be reversed? We’re looking for either:
- Immediate refund to the original card for the $4,312.45 and reversal of VAT, or
- A supplier credit (credit memo) plus confirmation of VAT correction on the tax reporting side.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — we need to close this in this billing cycle.

Best,
Jordan Pierce
Head of Finance, FastStream Inc.
(Attachment: invoice_20270401.pdf, usage_export_20270401-20270415.csv, screenshot_charge_detail.png)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected connector charges + VAT on marketplace credits — Findings & proposed remediation

Hi Jordan / Maya — I reviewed the invoice, the usage export, and routing logs for April 1. Summary below: 

— Root cause: a routing tag misclassification in our marketplace redemption service caused a subset of connector transactions to be billed under the customer-hosted plan instead of being debited against the marketplace credit balance. The bug affected transactions between 2027-03-29 22:00 UTC and 2027-04-01 06:30 UTC.

— Financial impact: $4,312.45 charged to FastStream’s card (invoice #2027-04-01-INV-8897). VAT amount included: $312.45 (itemized on invoice).

Proposed remediation options (pick one):
1) Immediate refund of $4,312.45 to the card ending in 4242 + VAT reversal on our tax records. Refund processed once we have authorization to refund to that card. Expected timeline: funds show on card in 5–7 business days after issuing. We will also issue a credit memo that notes the VAT reversal for your records.

2) Apply a credit memo for $4,312.45 to your next invoice and produce a VAT adjustment in our monthly tax filings (needs confirmation of VAT treatment). Credit will be visible on the next statement; tax note added to your portal.

VAT specifics: we can reverse VAT only if we have the appropriate tax documentation. For FastStream (US entity) we need the company EIN and a copy of the W-9 on file. If you are an EU entity claiming reverse charge, we need your VAT ID. Please let us know which applies.

Attached: draft credit memo for internal review (credit_memo_draft_70123.pdf). If you confirm refund to the card, reply with authorization and we’ll start the refund immediately. If you want a credit, confirm that preference and we’ll place the credit on the next billing cycle and flag the tax adjustment.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up with a postmortem on the misclassification and corrective deploy schedule.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing & Payments Specialist, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: credit_memo_draft_70123.pdf)
